openChanges.name: Black Girls Do Run UK — North West London
openChanges.currentValue: Black women and women of colour, including people new to running.
openChanges.proposedValue: Black women and women of colour aged 18 and over, including people new to running.
openChanges.reason: Include the explicit minimum age stated on the local programme page so callers can check suitability before joining.
openChanges.evidence: The North West London programme describes encouraging Black women aged 18 and over to run and welcomes people just starting out.

openChanges.name: Brent Resident Support Fund — crisis payment
openChanges.currentValue: Evidence required. Normally one application per rolling 12 months, even if a previous application was declined. Awards are discretionary.
openChanges.proposedValue: Evidence required. One application per rolling 12 months, even if declined. For couples, an application by either partner counts towards this limit; it does not apply to other adult household members. Awards are discretionary.
openChanges.reason: The council states a firm rolling application limit and explicitly applies it to couples; the listing omits the partner rule and says normally.
openChanges.evidence: One application is allowed in a rolling 12 months, approved or rejected. A partner application during that period is declined; other adults in the household are not included in this partner restriction.
